name: Superman
steps: Lie flat face down on the floor with your arms extended straight overhead and your legs extended straight behind you.
Keep your neck neutral looking down at the floor and brace your abs lightly.
Simultaneously lift your chest, arms, and straight legs smoothly off the floor by squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Pause briefly at the top of the lift, then lower your arms and legs slowly back down to the floor.
tips: Lift through a smooth, controlled range rather than jerking aggressively into extreme spinal hyperextension.
Keep your gaze directed toward the floor ahead of you so you do not crane your neck backward.
